import json
import sys
import re

# Read queue file
with open(sys.argv[1], 'r') as f:
    queue = json.load(f)

items = queue['items'][:int(sys.argv[2])]  # BATCH_SIZE

# Extract potential symbols from titles and test procedures
symbols_to_search = set()
keyword_patterns = [
    r'\b([A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*(?:Pool|Manager|Service|Handler|Validator|Store|Cache|Queue))\b',  # Common Go patterns
    r'\b(Validate[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\b',  # Validation functions
    r'\b(Process[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\b',  # Processing functions
    r'\b([A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*Column[s]?)\b',  # Data column related
    r'\bgossip[- ]?(\w+)',  # Gossip-related
    r'\bKZG\b',  # KZG verification
    r'\bP2P\b',  # P2P layer
    r'\b(subnet|publishing|subscription)\b',  # Common terms
]

for item in items:
    title = item.get('title', '')
    test_proc = item.get('test_procedure', '')
    combined = f"{title} {test_proc}"
    
    for pattern in keyword_patterns:
        matches = re.findall(pattern, combined, re.IGNORECASE)
        symbols_to_search.update(matches)

# Print unique symbols (for debugging)
print(json.dumps({
    'total_items': len(items),
    'unique_symbols': sorted(list(symbols_to_search)[:50]),  # First 50
    'sample_titles': [item['title'] for item in items[:5]]
}, indent=2))
EOF
